items.prompt: Pawlu ___ mal-kantuniera u ra l-baħar.
items.explanation: Here Pawlu is moving. Dar is the past tense of turning. Dahar means back, and id-dar is the house.

items.prompt: Dan ___ lbieraħ filgħaxija.
items.explanation: Ġara is a verb here because the sentence says when something happened. A female neighbour can be il-ġara.

items.prompt: Iz-zija ___ aħjar wara li straħet.
items.explanation: Ħassha means she felt. Ħassa is lettuce.

items.prompt: Is-sewwieq ___ il-kaxxi minn fuq it-trakk.
items.explanation: Ħatt means he unloaded. Ħadt means I took and ħadd refers to a person in expressions such as ma kien hemm ħadd.

items.prompt: Il-ħanut qiegħed ___ ta' ġebla minn hawn.
items.explanation: Tefgħa is a noun for a throw. Tefgħa ta' ġebla is a short distance, a stone's throw.

items.prompt: Waħħalt ir-ritratt bil-___.
items.explanation: Kolla is the glue used to stick the photo down. Kollha means all of them or all of it, depending on the noun.

items.prompt: Write the missing verb. Qabel ħareġ, ___ d-dawl. (Before leaving, he turned off the light.)
items.hint: The spelling depends on whether he turned off the light or threw something.
items.explanation: Tefa means he turned off. Tefa' with a final apostrophe means he threw.

items.prompt: Match each Maltese word with its synonym.
items.explanation: Each pair shares a meaning in this context. The words refer to a driver, hope, a hobby and a holiday.

items.prompt: Replace is-sewwieq with the right form of xufier. Write the whole sentence. Is-sewwieq waqaf ħdejn l-iskola.
items.answerTranslation: The driver stopped near the school.
items.hint: Check the sound at the start of xufier.
items.explanation: The article becomes ix- before x. The meaning of the sentence stays the same.

items.prompt: Use bxara in place of aħbar. Write the whole sentence. Feraħ bl-aħbar it-tajba.
items.answerTranslation: He was pleased with the good news.
items.hint: Check what happens to bl- and to the article before the adjective.
items.explanation: Aħbar starts with a vowel, so it follows bl-. With bxara, use bil-bxara. After bxara ends in a vowel, it-tajba becomes t-tajba.

items.prompt: Replace tqil with a synonym for difficult. Write the whole sentence. Kien eżami tqil.
items.hint: Look at how tqil is used in the examples about exams.
items.explanation: Diffiċli keeps the meaning of tqil in this sentence about an exam.

items.prompt: Xi tfisser il-kelma Ingliża «junk»?
items.explanation: In the first paragraph, the teacher explains that the English word junk means żibel (rubbish).

items.prompt: Liema ikel fih ħafna melħ skont it-tikketta?
items.explanation: The text says that the crisps contain a lot of salt. It links the biscuits with sugar.

items.prompt: X'fihom il-gallettini skont it-tikketta? Complete the answer. Il-gallettini fihom ___.
items.answerTranslation: The biscuits contain a lot of sugar.
items.hint: Find the sentence about il-gallettini in the second paragraph.
items.explanation: The text says il-gallettini fihom ħafna zokkor. Fihom is plural because it refers to the biscuits.

items.prompt: Fejn issajjar il-patata Lara? Complete the answer. Lara ssajjar il-patata ___.
items.answerTranslation: Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven.
items.hint: Look at the first sentence of the third paragraph.
items.explanation: Lara cooks the potatoes fil-forn (in the oven) at home.

items.prompt: X'jagħżel Daniel għall-brejk?
items.explanation: Daniel takes an apple from his bag for his break. Tuffieħa is the singular for an apple.

items.prompt: F'liema grupp insibu l-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt?
choices: Jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-laħam u l-ħut.
items.explanation: The last paragraph puts milk, cheese and yoghurt in the dairy group, prodotti tal-ħalib.

items.prompt: Choose dar or dahar. Write the whole sentence. Pawlu ___ mal-kantuniera.
items.hint: Pawlu is doing something at the corner. Choose the verb.
items.explanation: Dar is the verb for “he turned” here. Dahar means the back of a person or thing.

items.prompt: Use xufier in this sentence and change the article. Is-sewwieq waqaf ħdejn l-iskola.
items.answerTranslation: The driver stopped near the school.
items.hint: The article before x uses the same consonant as xufier.
items.explanation: Is-sewwieq and ix-xufier both mean the driver. Before x, use the article ix-.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, fejn issajjar il-patata Lara? Complete the whole sentence. Lara ssajjar il-patata ___.
items.answerTranslation: Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven.
items.hint: Read the first sentence in the third paragraph.
items.explanation: In the reading, Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven. Fil-forn joins fi and il-forn.

items.prompt: You are writing to Maya. Choose Għażiża or Għeżież and write the whole greeting. ___ Maya, tislijiet minn Ruma!
accepted: Għażiża Maya, tislijiet sbieħ minn Ruma
Għażiża Maya tislijiet sbieħ minn Ruma
items.explanation: Għażiża is the feminine singular greeting. Għeżież is used to greet several people.

items.prompt: Choose qatt or qadd. Write the whole sentence. ___ ma rajt borra f'Malta.
items.answerTranslation: I've never seen snow in Malta.
items.hint: Look for the word that works with ma rajt to mean never.
items.explanation: Qatt ma means never. Qadd refers to the waist.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, x'fihom il-gallettini? Complete the whole sentence. Il-gallettini fihom ___.
items.answerTranslation: The biscuits contain a lot of sugar.
items.hint: Look for the biscuits in the second paragraph, where the class reads the labels.
items.explanation: The biscuits have a lot of sugar in the text. The crisps are the food the text links with salt.

items.prompt: Use bxara instead of aħbar and adapt the articles. Write the whole sentence. Feraħ bl-aħbar it-tajba.
items.answerTranslation: He was pleased with the good news.
items.hint: Bxara starts with a consonant and ends with a vowel. Check both parts of the phrase.
items.explanation: Use bil-bxara with the consonant b. After the final a in bxara, the i in it-tajba drops.

items.prompt: Use daq and daqq once each. Write the whole sentence. ___ il-kejk u mbagħad ___ il-pjanu.
items.answer: Daq il-kejk u mbagħad daqq il-pjanu
items.answerTranslation: He tasted the cake and then played the piano.
items.hint: With the cake he tasted something. With the piano he played something.
items.explanation: Daq with one q means he tasted. Daqq with two means he played an instrument.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, liema grupp hu dan? Complete the whole sentence. Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma ___.
items.answer: Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
items.answerTranslation: Milk, cheese and yoghurt are dairy products.
accepted: Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma l-prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
items.hint: The class names this group in the last paragraph.
items.explanation: Prodotti tal-ħalib means dairy products, the group that includes milk, cheese and yoghurt.

items.prompt: Use a synonym for tqil that means difficult. Write the whole sentence. Kien eżami tqil.
items.hint: Tqil describes difficulty when it refers to the exam in this sentence.
items.explanation: Diffiċli means difficult. With an exam, tqil can have that same meaning.

items.prompt: It was Sunday and nobody was in the shop. Use Ħadd and ħadd. Write the whole sentence. Nhar il-___, ma kien hemm ___ fil-ħanut.
items.answer: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
items.answerTranslation: On Sunday, nobody was in the shop.
accepted: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
Nhar il-Ħadd ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
items.hint: Nhar il- introduces a day. Ma kien hemm introduces the absence of people.
items.explanation: Il-Ħadd is Sunday. In ma kien hemm ħadd, ħadd means nobody because the verb is negative.

items.prompt: Close your postcard to several colleagues. Choose narak or narawkom and write the whole line. Għeżież kollegi, ___ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla!
items.answerTranslation: Dear colleagues, see you all next week!
items.hint: Several people will read the postcard. Choose the form addressed to more than one person.
items.explanation: Narawkom means we'll see you all. Narak is addressed to one person.
